bar.hint_empty: Add an audio file of this song. It plays under the tab and follows play, pause and every bar you click.
bar.hint_unaligned: Not lined up with the tab yet, so it may play ahead or behind. Drag bar 1 onto the first beat.
bar.hint_aligned: Lined up with the tab. Drifting while you play? Nudge it with [ and ].

editor.title: Backing track
editor.drop: Drop to add as a backing track
editor.drop_desktop_only: Adding files needs the desktop app
editor.empty_body: An audio file of the song — mp3, wav, flac. Add a few at once (drums, bass, vocals) and they play together as layers. You can also drop files anywhere on this screen.
editor.web_title: Backing tracks live in the desktop app
editor.web_body: They are audio files on your computer, which the browser can't play from. The video on the left works here too.
editor.step1: Press Sync automatically — or drag the yellow Bar 1 line onto the first beat yourself. To move every bar at once, drag the strip above the recording.
editor.step2: Press Play and listen. If a later bar drifts off its beat, drag that bar's line onto it — it stays pinned there.
editor.no_waveform: No waveform to show for this file.

intro.title: Play along with the real song
intro.lead: A backing track is a recording of the song that plays under the tab. It starts, stops and jumps with it — click any bar and the band is there too.
intro.step1_body: An audio file of the song — mp3, wav, flac. Have the drums, bass or vocals as separate files? Add them all and they play together as layers.
intro.step1_web: An audio file of the song — mp3, wav, flac. Files live on your computer, so this part works in the desktop app.
intro.step2_title: Line it up with the tab
intro.step2_body: Press Sync automatically and the app finds bar 1 and the tempo by itself, and follows a band that speeds up or drags. Not quite right? Drag a bar line onto the beat you see in the waveform.
intro.step3_title: Add a YouTube video, if you like
intro.step3_body: Paste a link and the video — the official one, a live cut, a lesson — plays above the tab, in sync. It is a picture only: it stays muted and the sound comes from your recording. This works in the browser too.

auto.title: Finds bar 1 and the tempo from the recording, and pins bars where the band drifts
auto.listen: Press Play and listen — if a bar is off, drag its line.
auto.unsure: Not sure about this one — the drums, the bass and the notes in the recording point to different places. Check by ear, or place bar 1 yourself.
auto.partial: This tab covers only about {{percent}}% of the recording, so at most that stretch can line up.

recordings.title: Backing tracks
recordings.desktop_only: Backing tracks are audio files on your computer, so they work in the desktop app.
recordings.solo_title: Hear only this one — press again for all
recordings.remove_title: Remove from this song (it stays in the library)

video.title: YouTube video
video.body: The official video, a live cut or a lesson to watch while you play. It plays above the tab, in sync and muted — the sound stays your backing track.
video.bad_link: That isn't a YouTube link — try youtube.com/watch?v=… or youtu.be/…
video.no_speed: YouTube has no speed for {{bpm}} BPM, so the picture may drift. The sound stays locked.
video.same_take_title: The video is the same recording as the files — give it the same sync

shift.label: Move all bars
shift.drag: Drag here to move all bars
shift.title: Moves bar 1 and every pinned bar together, so the tempo between them stays the same

sync.tempo_title: What the song runs at. Changing it sets the session tempo too, so the recording keeps sounding as recorded.
sync.unpin_title: Back to one tempo for the whole recording

transport.follow_title: Keep the view on the playhead
transport.keys: Scroll — zoom · Shift+scroll — move · [ ] — move all bars · Alt — drop without snapping · double-click a pinned bar — unpin

lane.aria: Recording and bar lines — drag a bar line onto its beat, drag elsewhere to move along the recording

lanes_aria.tab_seek: Tablature notes on the alignment timeline — click to play from there
lanes_aria.tab: Tablature notes on the alignment timeline
lanes_aria.overview: Backing track overview — click to jump to a part of the recording
